title: The same work on one tape
notes: Sipser's simulation of the w=w machine. Every move of the two-tape machine becomes a scan right to read the marked symbols and a scan back to update them, and tape 2 grows by shifting. Compare the two counts at the top.
ops: mark 0|1|=,_ -> copy -,$ S,R; copy 0,_ -> copy 0,0 R,R; copy 1,_ -> copy 1,1 R,R; copy =,_ -> back S,L; back =,0|1 -> back S,L; back =,$ -> check R,R; check 0,0 -> check R,R; check 1,1 -> check R,R; check _,_ -> accept S,S
